title: BRM Complex in Arabidopsis Adopts ncBAF-like Composition and Requires BRD Subunits for Assembly and Stability.
authors: Stachula, Paulina; Kapela, Katarzyna; Malecka, Ewelina; Jaronczyk, Kamila; Patryn, Jacek; Siwirykow, Nina; Bucholc, Maria; Marczak, Malgorzata; Kotlinski, Maciej; Archacki, Rafal
one_liner_zh: 该文研究拟南芥SWI/SNF染色质重塑复合物的组装与稳定性，属于蛋白复合物生化分析，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: ATP-dependent SWI/SNF chromatin remodelling complexes are conserved multi-subunit assemblies that control genome activity. Functions of SWI/SNF complexes in plant development and growth have been well established, but the architecture of particular assemblies is unclear. In this study, we elucidate the organization of Arabidopsis SWI/SNF complexes formed around a BRM catalytic subunit, and define the requirement of bromodomain-containing proteins BRD1/2/13 for the formation and stability of the entire complex. Using affinity purification followed by mass spectrometry, we identify a set of BRM-associated subunits and demonstrate that the BRM complexes strongly resemble mammalian non-canonical BAF complexes. Furthermore, we identify BDH1 and 2 proteins as components of the BRM complex and, using mutant analyses, show that BDH1/2 are important for vegetative and generative development, as well as hormonal responses. We further show that BRD1/2/13 represent unique subunits of the BRM complexes, and their depletion severely affects the integrity of the complex, resulting in the formation of residual assemblies. Finally, analyses of BRM complexes after proteasome inhibition revealed the existence of a module consisting of the ATPase, ARP, and BDH proteins, assembled with other subunits in a BRD-dependent manner. Together, our results suggest modular organization of plant SWI/SNF complexes and provide a biochemical explanation for mutant phenotypes.
abstract_zh: ATP依赖的SWI/SNF染色质重塑复合物是保守的多亚基组装体，控制基因组活性。SWI/SNF复合物在植物发育和生长中的功能已被充分确立，但特定组装体的结构尚不清楚。在本研究中，我们阐明了围绕BRM催化亚基形成的拟南芥SWI/SNF复合物的组织方式，并定义了含溴结构域蛋白BRD1/2/13对整体复合物形成和稳定性的需求。通过亲和纯化结合质谱分析，我们鉴定了一组BRM相关亚基，并证明BRM复合物与哺乳动物非经典BAF复合物高度相似。此外，我们鉴定出BDH1和2蛋白为BRM复合物的组分，并通过突变体分析表明，BDH1/2对营养和生殖发育以及激素响应至关重要。我们进一步显示，BRD1/2/13代表BRM复合物的独特亚基，其缺失严重损害复合物的完整性，导致残余组装体的形成。最后，对蛋白酶体抑制后BRM复合物的分析揭示了由ATPase、ARP和BDH蛋白组成的模块的存在，该模块以BRD依赖方式与其他亚基组装。综合来看，我们的结果表明植物SWI/SNF复合物具有模块化组织，并为突变体表型提供了生化解释。
